user.title: Add a Blustream device
user.description: Enter the host and port of your Blustream DMP168. The optional MAC address is shown on the device's web GUI Information page; supply it for a stable identity that survives IP changes.

discovery_confirm.title: Blustream DMP168 discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Found Blustream DMP168 at {host} (MAC {mac}). Add it?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Blustream device
reconfigure.description: Update the host, port, or MAC address of your Blustream DMP168. Leaving the MAC field empty keeps the existing identity.

error.invalid_mac: The MAC address is not well-formed.

abort.mac_mismatch: The MAC address does not match the configured device. A repair issue has been raised so you can confirm whether to replace the device or restore the stored identity.

reboot_failed.message: Failed to reboot the Blustream device: it is unreachable on its control channel.

init.title: Blustream device MAC mismatch
init.description: A different MAC address ({discovered_mac}) was observed at the host previously associated with MAC {stored_mac}. Did you replace the physical device, or is this a transient observation?

menu_options.confirm_replacement: Confirm replacement (adopt the new MAC and keep entity history)
menu_options.restore: Restore (keep the stored identity; treat the new MAC as transient)
